project: MailPin — Email Follow-up & Productivity for Thunderbird
invariants: No native unread/new/total counter mutation
Pinning never changes read state
No network, telemetry, ads, CDN or remote code
No message bodies or attachment contents stored
No eval/new Function/innerHTML/outerHTML
SQLite writes remain incremental, transactional and serialized
All injected resources are cleaned up
No remote publication without explicit approval
No client-side administrator role or privilege switch
Privileged API inputs are bounded and normalized
Uninstall closes storage before deleting all MailPin profile data
Missing native install sentinel triggers residue purge before preferences/SQLite load
CI installs no third-party Python helper and pins GitHub Actions by immutable SHA
Only exact MailPin-owned Thunderbird tags may be managed or removed
Options and dashboard text has a 12px minimum font-size floor
Provider detection uses exact domain or legitimate subdomain boundaries, never arbitrary URL substrings
Optional Thunderbird capabilities fail locally instead of disabling the full extension
Business modules do not call Thunderbird core services directly outside compatibility adapters
Recommended mode never auto-saves and preserves profile-specific settings
Privileged dependencies injected into compatibility adapters are explicitly imported before facade creation
Organic Workspace uses native HTML plus local CSS tokens, with canonical Dashboard/Options shells written directly in source and no remote UI asset
Selected-account scope uses Thunderbird account.key consistently from Options through runtime filtering

security.uninstallLifecycle: AddonManager early signal + awaited Gecko Management uninstall purge + core-cleared ExtensionStorage reinstall sentinel
security.ciSupplyChain: stdlib-only checks, immutable action SHAs, no persisted checkout credentials, Dependabot monitoring
security.providerDetection: exact recognized domain or dot-boundary subdomain matching; CodeQL incomplete URL substring checks removed in 1.2.1
security.thunderbirdBoundary: MailServices/MailUtils/MessageArchiver and Calendar internals are injected into dedicated compatibility adapters; business logic must not call them directly
security.recommendedMode: recommended values are draft-only, preserve profile-specific fields and require explicit save
security.uiDependencyPolicy: native HTML plus local Organic Workspace CSS tokens; canonical shell in source; no npm runtime dependency, bundler, CDN or remote asset
security.runtimeTestSupplyChain: test-only Thunderbird/geckodriver downloads are checksum-verified and are not runtime dependencies of the extension

testing.browserStatus: Chromium DOM-flow and geometry evidence predates the branding-only release delta and remains applicable to unchanged business/layout behavior; MailPin identity/palette are covered by current static/UI guards.
testing.runtimeStatus: MailPin 1.6.0 rebrand runtime commit 4fdb978e1828325001f95951c115059a931b8b6e passed Linux/Windows QA, security guard and real Thunderbird 153 smoke. MailPin 1.6.1 changes only manifest version plus publication/reviewer metadata; its release process must rerun full QA and real Thunderbird smoke. No fresh manual 1.6.1 XPI acceptance is claimed.
